Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH team,

Thank you for your offer and for outlining the proposed annual volume, contract term and lead time. We are ready to make a firm longer-term commitment in return for securing the full requested annual volume, with flexibility to discuss the lead time. Please let us know what adjustments you can accommodate within your approval authority as a first step.

We confirm a binding volume of 23,400 units per year for 24 months. Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed +1.7% from 2025-12 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-12, idx:LCI-C@2026-06), well below the +7.7% you ask for. Producer prices DE: other rubber products changed +3.2% from 2026-02 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2219@2026-02, idx:PPI-C2219@2026-08), well below the +7.7% you ask for. Our should-cost estimate for Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM is EUR 24.31 per 1 (cost:340010).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (unit_price 27.69, volume_per_year 23400, contract_months 24, lead_time_days 35). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

We accept the proposed volume of 23,400 units and the 24-month contract duration. A lead time reduction to 35 days is technically unfeasible; we must maintain 54 days. We propose a unit price of EUR 32.00 under these conditions and request the full breakdown of your should-cost estimate.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. We present an Angebot with a price of €35.00 per unit, Lieferzeit 35 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. Our Lieferzeit is 35 days. Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 54 days: a price of €32.00 per unit, Lieferzeit 54 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
